reproducible_baseline_recheck.scope: Only model_lineage and managed_run modules from the fixed baseline are loaded in memory in an isolated process. The current shared data_separation producer retains the old behavior. No filesystem rollback or live project is used.

test_adaptations: One existing managed-outcome unit test now spies on read_data_separation_receipt instead of ensure_data_separation. Its assertions were preserved; frozen real-Lake behavioral tests separately prove that branch rejects missing/corrupt receipts without repair.
verified_boundaries: 12 baseline data-separation miss cases each perform 2 manifest reads, 1 audit lock, 1 temporary index directory and 1 receipt publication. Two other baseline cases recreate a missing compute receipt directory. All 14 now reject without those side effects.
Tests compare the complete synthetic durable tree and exact bytes before checking rejection; spies wrap real audit/storage operations, not the qualifier.
Real local/shared qualification, campaign audit, benchmark receipt/ledger verification and the independent managed-outcome separation branch are exercised.
Valid existing receipts remain accepted; artifact, terminal and boundary-policy drift remain rejected.

Receipt-only API validates policy/envelope/hash/counts and before/after manifest metadata; valid reads never open manifest bodies. Missing directories, redirects, malformed policy and a concurrent metadata change reject without mkdir/audit.
Training launcher and model-lineage finalization retain their producer paths. Existing related tests preserve full artifact double hashes and benchmark binding.
limits: V1-01 and V1 remain open. This is a corrective shared observer boundary slice discovered while checking the next consumer, not a completed general research framework.
I2 proved catalog/CLI non-migrating authority reads but did not cover this opt-in lineage audit side effect. This evidence supplements rather than retroactively expands the earlier tests.
Read-only refers to these evidence consumers; report/admin derived files may still be published and OS read atime is not frozen.
Model artifacts are still double-read and hashed. No claim that every evidence query is cheap or that research efficiency improved.
Existing metadata/receipt cache trust model remains; this is not protection against an attacker controlling the underlying filesystem and not a global filesystem/SQLite snapshot.
Legacy offline report warm cache may miss manifest metadata changes; native ranking requalifies every time. All old consumers are not migrated.
A regenerated receipt has a new digest and may not match historical attempt bindings. Observers do not fabricate or silently repair that provenance.

Only tiny synthetic manifests/models, real temporary SQLite, local pipe attestations and explicitly synthetic benchmark receipts were used. No actual training/GPU, paid provider, production license activation, package publication, deployment or live campaign writes.
